name: Preset language
description: Starts the game in the chosen language and skips the language select screen. USA and Japanese are on the disc but the screen never offers them; Japanese also shows the Japanese release's intro screen. Português (Brasil) is a fan translation: the English game with the entries of its text pack (pt_br.pack in this mod's folder) in place of the English text; without the pack it plays in English.

options.name: Language
options.description: The game's text language. Takes effect at the next start.
